feature: weighted-round-robin child policy inside SharedChannel weighted_target

scope.scheduler: grpc-core-compatible static stride with child hierarchy filtering

contracts: weighted_target delegates one READY child picker
WRR unknown weights use the nonzero mean
blackout and expiration are evaluated per policy instance
static stride consumes only available workers from that instance
missing or expired weights fall back to round-robin

implementation.filtered_scheduler: Scheduler rebuildFiltered and pickFiltered accept a comptime predicate plus context while legacy wrappers remain zero-cost
implementation.subset: mean substitution, scaling, generation checks, availability and fallback see only workers under the leaf path
implementation.ownership: each leaf owns config, scheduler entries, sequence and optional encoded OOB request
implementation.per_rpc_gate: Worker asks State for its exact leaf config before parsing ORCA trailers
implementation.oob_gate: Worker opens an OOB stream only when its exact leaf owns an OOB config
implementation.watch: endpoint ORCA watches remain available when any weighted leaf enables OOB
implementation.disconnect: worker disconnect/removal invalidates only the matching leaf scheduler generation

per_rpc: two matching workers report QPS weights 1 and 3
one READY unmatched sibling reports weight 100 but remains outside the scheduler
after two-second expiration 40 calls return to exact 1:1 round-robin
oob: one matching worker opens the configured ORCA stream and publishes a watch update
the report updates its WRR weight
one READY unmatched sibling opens no weighted OOB stream and retains no weight

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC SharedChannel weighted target WRR' --summary all
remaining_gap: outlier children, resolver churn, and ordinary Channel remain before broad weighted_target completion
